metadata.description: A generic, database-backed job queue for Exponential: seven priority classes with fair (stride) scheduling, aging and a starvation guard, per-user and per-site quotas, per-resource concurrency limits that adapt to rate-limit hints, leases with a reaper, retries with exponential backoff and jitter, a dead letter, idempotency keys, job groups, a result checkpoint for handlers, workers for the command line, cron and systemd, an admin dashboard and a command line interface. Works on MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle and MongoDB.
